name: Init PostgREST Test DB
description: TEST-ONLY. Runs on the postgres dependency before postgrest starts. Creates the `postgrest` login role (mTLS cert CN), the `web_anon` anon role (db_anon_role default), a sample public table, the grants, and the pgrst_watch reload trigger — so every postgrest livetest scenario has a working database. Production proxvex creates NO database SQL; the operator does this (see json/applications/postgrest/application.md, ## Database setup).
